_note: PUT this to /v2/acts/{actorId} as a pricingInfos array entry. PAY_PER_EVENT only on BRONZE. startedAt must be 14+ days out. Apify auto-adds 20% margin. NOTE: this pipeline calls sec-8k-event-tracker and sec-form4-insider-tracker, whose own per-event charges also bill the buyer. Both children are EDGAR HTTP (no browser, no proxy), so compute per run is tiny and these prices stay well above it even on a thin run. Free tier kept to 1 high_conviction so any run with billable events covers compute.

catalyst_watch.eventDescription: One material 8-K event with no insider buying in the window. Includes the item codes, materiality, filing link, and the insider buy/sell tally.

catalyst_elevated.eventDescription: One material 8-K event, or any event with insider open-market buying in the window. Includes the event detail plus the insider buy/sell counts and dollar values.

catalyst_high_conviction.eventDescription: A material 8-K event with net insider open-market buying in the window and a conviction score of 60 or higher. Insiders backing a material event with their own money. Includes full event and insider buy detail. The first high conviction event per run is free so you can validate output.
